cards.title: One Build-Out
items: October 19 is a single ~21 minute session: readme, brief, all application code, tests, samples, build and API docs
The entire backend lands in one commit (b30aa40) with no incremental history to review
Sample fixtures and captured response screenshots are the only non-code artefacts

cards.title: One Behaviour Change
items: October 21 (205891e) is the only commit that changes runtime behaviour: Tesseract gets an explicit host datapath
That change is what makes the OCR image path work on a Windows host with Tesseract installed
Everything else on October 21 is diagram housekeeping, not product code

cards.title: How to Read
items: Event times are the commits' own timestamps; author and committer dates are identical on this branch
The axis break marks the two-day gap between the build-out and the OCR change
The two housekeeping commits have no citable file at this revision — the paths they touched were deleted or excluded — so they are read from git history alone
